content.title: Who Is Rick Pitino's Wife, Joanne Minardi? All About St John's Head Coach's Partner And Children
content.text: Rick Pitino is a Hall of Fame basketball coach who currently serves as the head coach at St John's University. He is currently leading the Red Storm through the NCAA Tournament, having recently achieved his 900th career victory in February 2026. On March 22, 2026, he guided team St. Johns to defeat Kansas and bag their first Sweet 16 appearance since 1999. St John's Red Storm basketball team's stellar achievement has brought Rick Pitino into the spotlight, with a soaring interest in his family life. Here's everything we know about his wife, Joanne Minardi and their bond. Who is Rick Pitino's wife, Joanne Minardi? Joanne Minardi is the wife of legendary college basketball coach, Rick Pitino, who is currently the head coach at St. John's University. She is known as Rick's biggest supporter, often seen at his team's basketball games. Joanne stayed by her husband through thick and thin for nearly five decades. Throughout her husband's career, which has included stops at Louisville, Kentucky, Iona, and in the NBA, she has been known for her consistent support, reportedly never missing a home game during his eight seasons at Louisville. Regarding her profession, before her marriage, she worked as a flight attendant. How did Rick Pitino and Joanne Minardi's love story start? Rick Pitino and Joanne Minardi's relationship began as a high school romance on Long Island. They met in the 1970s during the summer when they were both students at St. Dominic's High School in Oyster Bay, Long Island, according to heavy.com. They were reportedly introduced by Joanne's brother, Bill Minardi (popularly known as Billy), who was one of Rick's high school classmates and also his best friend. Rick Pitino often joked that he only married Joanne to stay close to his closest pal, Billy. Throughout high school, Rick, Joanne and Billy always stayed together, becoming an inseparable trio. Rick Pitino and Joanne Minardi's marriage and children Rick and Joanne got married on April 3, 1976. Despite public scandals and personal tragedies, they remain married. The couple had six children; however, as of March 2026, only five are alive. Their five surviving kids include four sons, Michael, Christopher, Richard and Ryan Pitino and their only daughter, Jacqueline Pitino. Not much is known about them because their parents chose to maintain a private familial life. Among the kids, Richard is the most public-facing one. He followed his father's footsteps into basketball coaching. Continue reading below Richard Pitino is currently the head coach of the Xavier Musketeers and has previously served as the head coach at New Mexico, Minnesota, and FIU. Born September 16, 1982, he is 43 years old as of March 2026. Richard's youngest brother and Rick and Joanne's sixth child, Daniel Pitino tragically passed away in 1987 at just six months of age due to congenital heart failure. In his memory, the Pitino family established the Daniel Pitino Foundation and a shelter in Owensboro, Kentucky, to assist children in need. Besides their youngest child's death, Rick Pitino and Joanne Minardi also dealt with the loss of her brother After having gone past the death of their youngest kid, Daniel, Rick Pitino and Joanne Minardi faced another massive tragedy. Fourteen years after Daniel's passing, the couple had to deal with the loss of one of the closest people in their lives, i.e., Joanne's brother, Billy Minardi. Billy was killed in the 9/11 attacks. He was a bond broker for Cantor Fitzgerald and was working on the 105th floor of the North Tower of the World Trade Centre when it was hit. Before being Rick Pitino's brother-in-law, he was his closest friend since high school, which made Rick's loss even more unbearable. Even years after Billy's death, Rick still speaks about him in interviews. Joanne Minardi faced another blow when Rick Pitino admitted to infidelity In 2009, Rick Pitino admitted to having slept with Karen Sypher once. The encounter reportedly took place in August 2003 at Porcini, an Italian restaurant in Louisville, Kentucky, after it had closed for the night. Rick testified that weeks later, Karen informed him that she was pregnant. He said that he provided her with USD 3,000, which was used for an abortion. The college basketball coach initially claimed that he believed the money was for medical insurance and counselling. The infidelity became public when Karen Sypher attempted to extort USD 10 million from Rick in exchange for her silence regarding allegations that he forced her to have a physical encounter with him. The claims of an unconsensual physical encounter were later dismissed by investigators as baseless. In 2011, Karen Sypher was reportedly convicted of extortion and lying to the FBI, receiving a sentence of 7 years and 2 months in federal prison. Despite the public nature of the scandal, Joanne Minardi and their family chose to stand by Rick Pitino. Joanne's sister, Mary Vogt, stated in 2009 that the family had forgiven Pitino for the adultery and that the couple remained "happily married." As of March 2026, Rick and his wife are still together, having spent about 50 years of spousal life. What are your thoughts on Rick Pitino and Joanne Minardi having gone past life's struggles together? Let us know.
